statement: Foliage skips unencodable filenames with a diagnostic and loads valid neighbours in UTF-8 order. Scan and file I/O failures roll back, report failure to the gameplay cache, and allow retry; valid empty directories succeed. Creature dependency loading contains conversion exceptions and refuses incomplete identity. LoadFromDirectory appends on success, resets io_failed on entry, preserves existing errors and distinguishes empty success from I/O failure. Interactive farming retries failures every five seconds of frame time, logs changed errors and recovery once, and caches all successful loads.

evidence.detail: Foliage and creature directory loaders refuse directories and entries outside capture content trees, report failure with or without an optional output flag, and preserve previously loaded templates. Native execution remains pending.
